text:
Maya Lopez: Quick pitch for "Gratitude Day" the week before Q3 close: single-day pop-up celebration + rapid spot-awards station. goal: low-friction, hybrid-first, lots of micro-recognition. :sparkles:
Trevor Nguyen: Love it. How will hybrid folks participate?
Maya Lopez: two paths: 1) in-person kiosk (tablet + postcard station) 2) remote form that triggers e-gift codes and an optional mailed token. keep it under 90s to nominate.
Zoe Park: Facilities: can we use the mezzanine table? I can reserve and get a small easel for the poster.
Calvin Reed: Procurement/Finance: budget estimate? and vendor preference (e-gift vs physical)?
Maya Lopez: rough ask: 75 micro kudos @ $15 avg = $1,125 + 5 surprise spot awards $75 = $375 => total ~ $1.5k buffer. prefer e-gifts for speed but have a small physical token for in-person winners.
Ava Morgan: Legal note: include consent text for photos and a short shipping privacy blurb. I'll draft wording.
people-bot: Tip: use `/issue-spot-award <recipient> <amount> <reason>` to record awards. Tag with `#gratitude-day` for reporting.
Trevor Nguyen: Volunteers: need 2 people per 90-minute shift to man the kiosk and review remote queue. I can coordinate volunteers from Eng.
Zoe Park: I'll snag the mezzanine for Fri 11-2. need 1 table, 2 chairs, power and a small waste bin.
Calvin Reed: For PO: vendor email + tax ID required. digital cards OK; if you want branded physical mini trophies, that needs inventory tagging.
Maya Lopez: keep trophies minimal. can we do a tiny enamel pin? optional.
Ava Morgan: Draft consent line: "I consent to Redwood using my photo and name for internal communications and opt-in public channels. I consent to provide address for award shipping." will post in the planning doc.
Trevor Nguyen: Remote flow: I'll build a short Google Form (3 fields: recipient, reason, ship? address). Form will write to sheet and I can run Zapier to call people-bot if needed. link: https://docs.google.com/forms/gratitudeday (WIP)
Maya Lopez: nice. add an opt-out toggle for being posted on Slack/IG.
people-bot: Event automation note: volunteers tagged with `#gratitude-day-vol` will get a DM 24h before their slot.
Zoe Park: poster mock in the doc. will print 10 small posters and 1 A1 backdrop for the photo spot.
Calvin Reed: Approving provisional budget of $1.6k pending PO. submit by Wed so procurement can process.
Maya Lopez: action items: Trevor build form + volunteers by Tue; Ava finalize consent + short script for volunteers by Tue; Zoe reserve mezzanine + print posters; Calvin submit PO template and fast-track vendor.
Trevor Nguyen: volunteer script draft: "Hi! Want to give a quick shout-out? It'll take <60s. Photo opt-in?" super short.
Ava Morgan: also add a quick checkbox on the tablet: "I consent to photo & shipping (if requested)" with a link to the privacy blurb.
Maya Lopez: can we do a small "gratitude wall" of sticky notes so people can write micro-thanks? volunteers can stick them on the backdrop.
Zoe Park: facilities can bring sticky pads and a cork strip. good visual.
Calvin Reed: procurement note: if using e-gift vendor X we can upload CSV and deliver codes same-day; I'll confirm fees.
people-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Gratitude Day checklist" will auto-post 48h before event with a runbook link.
Trevor Nguyen: one more ask: can we include a tiny team leaderboard for fun? opt-in only.
Ava Morgan: legal ok if opt-in. add that toggle to the form.
Maya Lopez: thanks team. I'll open a short calendar invite for a 20min setup run Thu morning. closing thread, will reopen if any blockers. :heart:
